ينتبهوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَبِهُوا (yantabihū) /jan.ta.bi.huː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يُنْتَبَهُوا (yuntabahū) /jun.ta.ba.huː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
